name: Primary Localized Amyloidosis

criteria.description: Histopathological demonstration of amyloid deposits confined to a single organ or tissue without systemic involvement
Exclusion of systemic amyloidosis by negative fat pad biopsy and absence of monoclonal gammopathy in serum and urine
Clinical symptoms and signs localized to the affected organ consistent with amyloid deposition

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of localized amyloid deposits plus exclusion of systemic amyloidosis and presence of organ-specific clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires thorough systemic evaluation to exclude systemic amyloidosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Localized amyloid deposits confirmed by Congo red staining
searchTerms: localized amyloid deposits confirmed by special stain
protein deposits seen on Congo red stain

pathognomonic.symptomName: Localized tissue mass or nodule due to amyloid accumulation
pathognomonic.notes: Commonly presents as a localized tumor-like lesion

common.symptomName: Hoarseness due to laryngeal amyloid deposits
searchTerms: hoarseness from amyloid in voice box
voice changes due to laryngeal deposits

common.symptomName: Dysphagia from localized amyloid in the oropharynx or esophagus
common.notes: Common in upper GI tract involvement
searchTerms: difficulty swallowing from amyloid in throat

common.symptomName: Localized respiratory symptoms such as cough or airway obstruction

occasional.symptomName: Localized joint swelling or stiffness due to amyloid deposits
Localized ocular involvement causing conjunctival masses
occasional.notes: Rare but reported in localized amyloidosis

occasional.symptomName: Localized neuropathy from amyloid deposits in peripheral nerves

occasional.notes: May occur in oral or nasal mucosa

rare.symptomName: Localized cardiac amyloid deposits without systemic involvement
Localized renal amyloid deposits causing isolated proteinuria
searchTerms: protein in urine from kidney deposits

laboratory: Negative serum and urine immunofixation electrophoresis for monoclonal proteins
Normal fat pad biopsy without amyloid deposits
imaging: Localized soft tissue masses on MRI or CT corresponding to amyloid deposits
Absence of systemic organ involvement on whole-body imaging
genetic: No known germline mutations associated with systemic amyloidosis
other: Positive Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence under polarized light in localized tissue biopsy

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of localized plasma cell tumor

redFlags: Rapid progression of symptoms suggesting systemic amyloidosis
Evidence of monoclonal gammopathy in serum or urine
references: Merlini G, Bellotti V. Molecular mechanisms of amyloidosis. N Engl J Med. 2003;349(6):583-596.
Kyle RA, Gertz MA. Primary localized amyloidosis. Hematol Oncol Clin North Am. 1999;13(6):1231-1244.
